Strings.shelfDropZoneToggle: Keep dragged files near the tray icon
win.shelf.dropZoneToggle: Keep dragged files near the tray icon
win.shelf.dropZoneCaption: While you drag a file, a small shelf appears near the tray icon (or at the top center). Hover it to open the shelf; whatever you drop stays there as a pill with a count.
win.shelf.shakeCaption: Shake the pointer quickly from side to side while dragging something to summon the shelf near the cursor.
win.shelf.explorerSelection: Add the File Explorer selection with the shortcut
win.shelf.explorerSelectionCaption: With File Explorer in front, the shortcut opens the shelf with the selected files already in it. With nothing selected, it opens as usual.
win.shelf.exclusionsCaption: Shaking, the drop zone and the screen-edge peek stay off for drags started in these apps. The shortcut and Open now still work.
